faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a1: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and bank transfers through Stripe.
faq.q2: Can I change my plan later?
faq.a2: Yes, you can switch between modules and bundles at any time. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades take effect at the end of your billing cycle.
faq.a3: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all plans. Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time.
faq.q4: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.a4: Yes, every plan includes a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
faq.a5: You can subscribe to individual modules separately, but bundles offer significant savings. For example, Starter (Chat + Bubble) costs 39/month vs 58/month for both modules separately.
faq.a6: The EP Plan is designed for accredited parliamentary assistants and MEPs. It includes Chat, Bubble, and Amendator with EP-specific AI context and committee monitoring at a reduced rate.

story.title: From research question to policy action in minutes, not weeks
story.intro: Brubru’s AI understands EU institutional processes, legislative procedures, and policy context. Here’s how professionals use it every day.
story.step1Content: Type any EU policy question in natural language. Brubru’s AI draws on a knowledge base of 50,000+ EU laws, EP committee reports, Commission proposals, EPRS briefings, and 11 Beresol open reports covering topics from AI Act implementation to CBAM compliance.
story.step2Content: Set up RSS feeds from the European Parliament, Council, Commission, EUR-Lex, and more. Track specific legislative files through the Legislative Train, monitor EP committee work, and get alerts on public consultations with upcoming deadlines.
story.step3Content: Load any EU regulation or directive from EUR-Lex, select the article or recital you want to amend, and let the AI suggest changes. Export in Akoma Ntoso XML, PDF, or Word format following official EP formatting guidelines.
story.step4Content: Produce AI-powered position papers, MEP briefing notes, and talking points tailored to your policy area. Run compliance gap analysis with EU Law Comply to check how new legislation affects your organisation or sector.

api.eyebrow: For developers, RegTech, and AI agents
api.lede: Brubru is a vertical EU data provider. Our REST API gives you real-time access to 28,500+ adopted laws, 1,200+ legislative procedures, live consultation feedback, commissioner agendas, and the legal-text intelligence layer that powers Brubru's own chatbot and Amendator. Brubru itself is the first user of its own API.

quickstart.intro: Get your first API response in under two minutes.
quickstart.step1: Sign up at brubru.beresol.eu/subscription. Your API key will appear in your account settings within minutes.
quickstart.step3: Every endpoint returns the same paginated envelope. Extract the data array to iterate over results. Check has_more and next_page to paginate.

examples.intro: Copy-paste examples for the most common integrations.
examples.mcpDescription: Brubru exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral, or any MCP-compatible AI agent to give your assistant live EU legislative intelligence.

endpoints.laws: 28,500+ adopted EU laws. Filters by CELEX, doc type, policy area, publication date, full-text search.
endpoints.procedures: 1,200+ legislative files from proposal to adoption. Filters by OEIL reference, lead committee, rapporteur, last-update.
endpoints.consultations: Live stakeholder contributions from the EC Have Your Say portal. Paginated with country and user-type aggregates.
endpoints.commissioners: Live calendar items for all 27 college members. Name resolution is accent-insensitive.
endpoints.recitalMap: TF-IDF cosine mapping of recitals to articles for any law. Top-3 recitals per article.
endpoints.definedTerms: Article 3/4-style definitions dictionary. Hover-ready for annotating legal text.
endpoints.resolveRefs: Plain text in, structured CELEX citations out. Optional HTML annotation.
endpoints.resolveAliases: Resolve human names (GDPR, DSA, AI Act, CBAM, ...) to CELEX. 680+ aliases.

auth.description: Every /api/v1/* endpoint requires an API key. Pass it as Authorization: Bearer <key> (recommended) or X-API-Key: <key>. Keys are minted by Brubru's admin team for Professional subscribers. Rate limit is 60 requests per minute per key.
auth.note: X-API-Key is also accepted for curl-friendly scripts. Bearer is the default for Postman, OpenAPI tooling, and SDKs.

envelope.description: Every paginated endpoint returns the same shape. Partners can code once against the envelope and swap datasets by changing the path.

pricing.note: API-only usage does not consume chatbot/AI credits. Each Professional seat can mint one API key. For bulk exports, multiple keys, or custom SLAs,

errors.ok: Success. See X-RateLimit-Remaining for your remaining calls in the window.
errors.forbidden: Key valid but the owner is not on the Professional tier.
errors.rateLimited: Rate limit exceeded. Respect the Retry-After header.
errors.upstream: Upstream EU portal temporarily unavailable (e.g. Have Your Say, Commission calendar).
errors.envelopeNote: Error responses use a canonical envelope: { error, reason_code, request_id }. Every response also carries an X-Request-Id header for support traceability.
